class.name: WorkerThreadPool
class.brief_description: Runs managed callbacks on the game's native worker threads.
class.description: The singleton is available in the standalone game process. Submit, query, and reclaim tasks on the main thread. Callbacks must complete synchronously, use thread-safe data, and finish without waiting on the main thread or calling Ming object APIs.

method.name: AddTask
method.description: Queues one Action and retains the Callable until the task is reclaimed.
method.param: A Callable created from a synchronous Action with no MingObject target.
method.returns: A task ID, or -1 when the task could not be submitted.

method.name: AddGroupTask
method.description: Queues work for the given number of elements. The callback receives each index once in an unspecified order.
method.param: A Callable created from a synchronous Action of int with no MingObject target.
Number of elements to process. An empty group completes immediately.
Number of internal tasks. Pass -1 to use the pool's worker count.
method.returns: A group ID, or -1 when the group could not be submitted.

method.name: IsTaskCompleted
method.description: Returns whether the task has finished without reclaiming its ID.

method.name: IsGroupTaskCompleted
method.description: Returns whether the group has finished without reclaiming its ID.

method.name: WaitForTaskCompletion
method.description: Waits for the task and reclaims its ID. Returns false for an invalid or previously reclaimed ID.

method.name: WaitForGroupTaskCompletion
method.description: Waits for all group work and reclaims its ID. Returns false for an invalid or previously reclaimed ID.
